rounds.text: Team Lease Services Ltd carries significant valuation and structural risks supported by quantitative evidence. A discounted cash flow model explicitly puts intrinsic value at Rs 914 per share against a market price of Rs 1,299, leaving a negative margin of safety of -42.2% [E45, E46]. Furthermore, the reverse DCF indicates that today's price already demands an aggressive 9.8% earnings growth, which outpaces the 5.0% assumed in the base case [E47]. Institutional confidence is actively eroding, evidenced by foreign institutional holding plunging from 30.47% in September 2023 to just 6.95% by June 2026, alongside negative institutional money flow [E42, E44]. Fundamental momentum is also stalling sharply, with trailing twelve-month sales growth slowing to 3%, three-year compounded profit growth decelerating to 4%, and a yearly operating-margin trend that has been decreasing over the last six years [E17, E20, E32]. Conceded: the company demonstrates healthy cash generation with an operating cash flow of Rs 259 Cr and strong cash conversion of 2.67x against reported profit [E34, E35]. Nevertheless, the rules-based screen firmly scores the stock at a mediocre 37 out of 100, reflecting a sell rating with medium confidence [E65].
